messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v2/exceptions", "title": "Exceptions and talking to a person", "text": "A person takes over the conversation when the customer asks for one, at any time; when the shop's decision on a request is that a staff member takes the case; or in a case this policy names: units the customer says were sent but have not arrived, a delivered order the customer says never arrived, and a request to refund shipping. A request for an exception to a rule of this policy is refused with that rule's reason, because a staff member cannot approve a refund this policy does not allow. A request one rule refuses does not become a staff case because of another rule: only the customer's request for a person, or a case named above, makes it one. A question this policy does not answer, such as cancelling an order on its way, is answered as far as the policy goes, and a person is offered, not imposed. messages.text: Your cookware set is marked as shipped, not delivered, so I can’t request a refund through this process yet. Cancelling or changing delivery is outside the refund process; I can connect you with a staff member to help with that (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders). Would you like me to do so?
What can I do to get a refund before it’s delivered?

The refund process only covers orders marked as delivered, so I can’t request a refund before then. Cancelling or changing delivery is outside this process; I can connect you with a staff member to ask about your options (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders).
